title: 日本ダービーにむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Japanese Derby, and Gold City is fired up more than ever to rewrite her reputation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I warn her that reputations can't be overturned with just one race, but she doesn't take my advice to heart.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold City heads into the race to earn the title of Derby champion.
